hook: 差集 I 專場開在I資訊台——名牌用中文，防止走失。
script: icicle/idiomatic/idiosyncracy/idiosyncratic 先登台，其餘 orphan 接龍。清倉晚會續攤：同字母檢票，義核才是身份證。

members.senseAnchor: ice resembling a pendent spear, formed by the freezing of dripping water
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-冰柱: icicle walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-冰柱」出場：icicle 一上場梗就黏住——冰柱。

members.senseAnchor: of or relating to or conforming to idiom
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-通俗的；: idiomatic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-通俗的；」出場：idiomatic 一上場梗就黏住——通俗的；慣用的。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-特質: idiosyncracy walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-特質」出場：idiosyncracy 一上場梗就黏住——特質。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-n. 獨: idiosyncratic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-n. 獨」出場：idiosyncratic 一上場梗就黏住——n. 獨特的。

members.senseAnchor: excellent and delightful in all respects; suggestive of an idyll; charmingly simple and serene
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-田園詩的: idyllic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-田園詩的」出場：idyllic 一上場梗就黏住——田園詩的。

members.senseAnchor: completely lacking nobility in character or quality or purpose; ; - Oliver Wendell Holmes, Jr.; not of the nobility
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-可鄙的；: ignoble walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-可鄙的；」出場：ignoble 一上場梗就黏住——可鄙的；卑鄙的。

members.senseAnchor: (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame; - Rachel Carson
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-可鄙的；: ignominious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-可鄙的；」出場：ignominious 一上場梗就黏住——可鄙的；可恥的。

members.senseAnchor: contrary to accepted morality (especially sexual morality) or convention; contrary to or forbidden by law
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-違法: illicit walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-違法」出場：illicit 一上場梗就黏住——違法。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-智者: illuminati walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-智者」出場：illuminati 一上場梗就黏住——智者。

members.senseAnchor: based on or having the nature of an illusion
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-錯覺的: illusive walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-錯覺的」出場：illusive 一上場梗就黏住——錯覺的。

members.senseAnchor: a person of subnormal intelligence; having a mental age of three to seven years
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-愚蠢的人: imbecile walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-愚蠢的人」出場：imbecile 一上場梗就黏住——愚蠢的人。

related.synonyms: idiot, cretin, moron, changeling, half-wit, retard

members.senseAnchor: to take in (something liquid) through small openings
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-v. 喝: imbibe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-v. 喝」出場：imbibe 一上場梗就黏住——v. 喝水，攝取水分。

members.senseAnchor: an intricate and confusing interpersonal or political situation; a very embarrassing misunderstanding
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-紛亂: imbroglio walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-紛亂」出場：imbroglio 一上場梗就黏住——紛亂。

members.senseAnchor: spread or diffuse through; fill, soak, or imbue totally
members.speakLineEn: Cue the I席-染色: imbue walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「I席-染色」出場：imbue 一上場梗就黏住——染色。

related.synonyms: permeate, pervade, penetrate, interpenetrate, diffuse, riddle

pitfalls: 勿因同字母硬串錯誤字根
